goal_details.name: summarize
goal_details.response: For first-time startup founder ENT-803, the transition cap limits the recommended income to EUR 18,000/yr (YEL-POL-02). Per YEL-POL-03, the 22% beginner discount applies to the monthly premium.

story: New startup founder ENT-803 asks about recommended YEL income and beginner discount.
starting_sentence: New startup founder ENT-803 wants to know their recommended YEL income and whether they qualify for a beginner discount. Retrieve the profile, sector benchmark, and calculate the recommendation. Do NOT call yel_issue_decision — just report the recommended income, whether the beginner discount applies, and what their monthly premium would be.
